# ⚡ TeleportMod v1.4.0 — The Architecture Update (TPA & Bugfixes)

We are proud to present **TeleportMod 1.4.0**! This version introduces a complete, ground-up rewrite of the mod's architecture, shifting to an isolated, modular codebase (`Data`, `Logic`, and `Render`). This completely eliminates old rendering lags and introduces highly anticipated smart multiplayer features.

---

## 👥 New Feature: Intelligent TPA Request Engine (`B` Key)
Multiplayer teleportation management is finally here, and it’s fully automated!
* **Single-Tap `B`:** Triggers a fast **3-second network status overlay** above your hotbar. Displays the targeted player's name with live color indicators: **Green** (Online), **Yellow** (Pending Request sent within 15s), or **Red** (Offline / Not Selected).
* **Hold `B` (>300ms):** Automatically scans the server TAB list and opens a smooth, lag-free scrolling grid. Use **Up** and **Down** arrow keys to pick players. Releasing the key auto-locks the target and saves it to the configuration file on your drive.
* **Double-Tap `B`:** Instantly dispatches a perfectly formatted `/tpa` (or `/tp` for admins, switchable via settings) network packet to the selected user.
* **Auto-Scanner Prefix Stripper:** The mod automatically scrubs chat prefixes, color codes, rank tags, and bracketed text from server TAB displays (e.g., `§d[Admin] §6pudge §r` is processed into a pure, clean username: `pudge`).

---

## 🔧 Critical Bugfixes & Performance Enhancements
* **Fixed `Format error` Bugs:** Completely removed old legacy string-formatting methods that crashed game rendering or displayed text errors on non-default regional languages.
* **Fixed `NoSuchMethodError` Network Crash:** Rewrote the network execution pipeline. Commands are now safely processed inside Minecraft's main scheduled thread (`client.execute`), preventing game crashes on modern 1.21.X multiplayer environments.
* **Fixed UI Input Leakage:** Added an absolute GUI filter-shield. Macro detection completely sleeps when chat, inventories, shulker boxes, or server menus are active, ensuring 100% safety from accidental command triggers.
* **Native Multilingual Localization:** Migrated entire layout arrays to standard `Text.translatable()` rendering blocks. Added full language fallback, fixing broken placeholders on any regional version of English (UK, CA, AU) and Russian.
* **Fixed Configuration Memory Reset:** Rewrote the гибридный `.txt` configuration parser to support legacy layout reading, meaning your warps and settings won't get cleared when upgrading versions.

---

## ⚙️ Settings Mapping Additions (`M` Key)
* Expanded the control map to **14 active configuration options**.
* Added manual clipboard injection for player targets directly inside the settings page.
* Toggled options are now responsive to the **Left** and **Right** arrow keys for smooth time adjustment and seamless admin/user mode switching.

---

## 🛠️ Updated Roadmap
* [x] `/tpa` & `/tp` intelligent request engine (Released!)
* [ ] `/m` (Fast automated direct messaging macro shortcut slots)

---

# 🚀 TeleportMod v1.3.6 (Fabric 1.21.Х) - Official Release

Stable global release artifact. Fully compatible with Fabric API on the 1.21.X branch layout.

### 🎯 Key Enhancements in this Version:
*   **Zero-Delay RTP Engine:** Server packets are dispatched instantly with no client-side countdown blocks to prevent millisecond lag desyncs.
*   **Dynamic Localization Adapter:** Automatically adapts to any active client language framework (`en_us`, `ru_ru`.) via standard native game hooks.
*   **Dynamic Warp Configuration Layout:** Integrated clipboard injection framework allowing you to easily add or delete macro points on the fly.
*   **Encapsulated Reflection Core:** Re-engineered internal layout utilizing dynamic method reflection to guarantee 100% stability.

### ⌨️ Controls Cheat Sheet:
*   `Double O` - Trigger `/home o`
*   `Double R` - Trigger `/rtp` (Adaptive smart-cooldown colors inside action bar)
*   `Double C` - Trigger `/spawn`
*   `Hold P` - Open warp scrolls layout selector (**Up / Down** to scroll, release to teleport)
*   `Hold M (3s)` - Open options layout (**Up / Down** to select row, **Left / Right** to edit cooldown values, **Enter** to save changes, **Escape** to cancel)
